description.value: The study investigated cue-induced functional connectivity changes across alcohol-consumer subgroups and their associations with craving and compulsivity.

spans.text: In this study, we investigated functional connectivity changes during a cue-reactivity task across different subgroups of alcohol consumers.

value: We expected changes in functional connectivity across groups to scale with AUD severity.

Specifically, we hypothesized that during alcohol cue-exposure (a) functional connectivity between seed regions and the dlPFC would decrease, while (b) functional connectivity between seed regions and the OFC would increase as AUD severity increases.
In abstinent alcohol-dependent patients, we expected (c) strengthened functional connectivity between seed regions and the dlPFC compared with nonabstinent dependent drinkers.
Finally, we expected (d) functional connectivity change during alcohol cue-exposure to correlate with subjective craving and compulsivity of alcohol use.

description.value: A cross-sectional observational study compared four alcohol-consumer subgroups.

spans.text: Our investigation aimed to (a) identify cue-induced changes of functional connectivity in AUD individuals, (b) compare these changes between subgroups of alcohol consumers varying in AUD severity and abstinence state (light drinkers, heavy drinkers, nonabstinent alcohol-dependent drinkers, and abstinent alcohol-dependent patients), and (c) determine whether cue-induced changes of functional connectivity are related to craving or compulsive use.
Planned group comparisons of functional connectivity change were conducted between all groups, respectively.

T2* weighted echo-planar images (EPI) were recorded
A 3 Tesla whole-body tomograph (MAGNETOM Trio with TIM technology; Siemens Healthineers, Erlangen, Germany) was used for scanning.
T2* weighted echo-planar images (EPI) were recorded with a transversal orientation of 30° clockwise to the anterior commissures-posterior commissures (AC-PC) line.

The following scan parameters were used: repetition time (TR) = 2.41 seconds, echo time (TE) = 25 ms, flip angle = 80°, number of slices = 42, slice thickness = 2 mm, gap = 1 mm, voxel dimensions = 3 × 3 × 3 mm 3 , field of view (FOV) = 192 × 192 mm 2 , 64 × 64 in-plane resolution.
